label: EXISTING_THROUGH_SOMETHING_1: The original per aliquid / per aliquod locution concerns that through…
definition: The original per aliquid / per aliquod locution concerns that through which something has being. Chapter3 contrasts this with per nihil, while chapters5–6 distinguish material, efficient and instrumental senses and self-existence. It is not uniformly distinct efficient causation, modal necessity or the existing actual-concrete grounds relation.
